name: Nasi Goreng
description: A savoury Malaysian-style fried rice with chicken, egg and sambal.
descriptionZh: 鸡肉、鸡蛋和参巴酱炒成的香味十足马来西亚风味炒饭。
steps: Use cold cooked rice if possible. Break up any large clumps before cooking.
Mix the sambal, soy sauce, dark soy sauce and sugar in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Scramble the eggs until just set, then remove.
Add the remaining oil. Stir-fry the onion and garlic for 30–45 seconds, then add the chicken and cook until no longer pink.
Add the sambal mixture and stir-fry for about 20 seconds until fragrant.
Add the rice and toss over high heat for 2–3 minutes until the rice is hot and evenly coated.
Return the egg to the wok. Add salt only if needed, toss for another 30 seconds and serve.
stepsZh: 尽量使用隔夜冷饭，先把结块的米饭弄散。
将参巴酱、酱油、黑酱油和糖混合在小碗里。
锅中加入1汤匙油，中大火炒鸡蛋至刚凝固，盛起备用。
加入剩余的油，炒香洋葱和蒜约30–45秒，再加入鸡肉炒至不再粉红。
加入参巴酱汁，翻炒约20秒至香味出来。
加入米饭，大火翻炒2–3分钟，让米饭均匀裹上酱汁并彻底加热。
把鸡蛋放回锅中，试味后才决定是否需要加盐，再翻炒约30秒即可。

steps: Heat oil in a wok or frying pan.
Fry garlic, onion and chili until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook through.
Push ingredients aside and scramble the egg.
Add rice, sambal, soy sauce and dark soy sauce.
Stir-fry over medium-high heat until evenly mixed and hot.
Season to taste and serve immediately.
stepsZh: 锅中加油烧热。
加入蒜、洋葱和辣椒炒香。
加入鸡肉炒至熟透。
将食材推到一边，加入鸡蛋炒熟。
加入米饭、参巴、酱油和黑酱油。
用中大火翻炒至均匀并彻底加热。
调味后立即享用。

name: Egg Fried Rice
description: A simple Chinese-style egg fried rice with balanced soy seasoning.
descriptionZh: 简单的中式蛋炒饭，酱油调味恰到好处。
steps: Use cold cooked rice and break up any clumps.
Whisk the eggs with a small pinch of the salt.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add the eggs and scramble until about 80% set. Remove.
Add the remaining oil. Stir-fry the garlic and the white parts of the spring onion for 20–30 seconds.
Add the rice and toss over high heat for 2 minutes.
Pour the soy sauce around the hot side of the wok, then toss the rice quickly so the sauce spreads evenly without making the rice soggy.
Return the egg, add the remaining spring onion, white pepper and sesame oil. Toss for 30 seconds and serve.
stepsZh: 使用冷的熟饭，并先把结块弄散。
鸡蛋打散，加入少量盐。
锅中加入1汤匙油，中大火把鸡蛋炒至约八成熟，盛起备用。
加入剩余的油，炒香蒜和青葱白色部分约20–30秒。
加入米饭，大火翻炒约2分钟。
把酱油沿着锅边加入，再快速翻炒，让酱油均匀裹住米饭，同时避免米饭变湿。
加入鸡蛋、剩余青葱、白胡椒和麻油，翻炒约30秒即可。

steps: Heat oil in a wok or frying pan.
Fry garlic briefly, then add beaten eggs.
Scramble the eggs until just set.
Add rice and stir-fry over medium-high heat.
Add soy sauce, sesame oil and white pepper.
Add spring onion and toss until hot.
Serve immediately.
stepsZh: 锅中加油烧热。
炒香蒜后加入打散的鸡蛋。
将鸡蛋炒至刚刚凝固。
加入米饭，用中大火翻炒。
加入酱油、麻油和白胡椒。
加入青葱翻炒至热透。
立即享用。

name: Soy Sauce Chicken Rice
description: Tender chicken and potatoes braised in a balanced soy sauce gravy and served with rice.
descriptionZh: 鸡肉和马铃薯在咸香适中的酱油汁中焖煮，再配上米饭。
steps: Cut the chicken into medium pieces. Peel the potatoes and cut them into chunks.
Mix light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar and cooking wine in a bowl.
Heat the cooking oil in a pot. Fry the ginger and garlic for about 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and sear for 2–3 minutes until the outside is lightly browned.
Add the potatoes and soy mixture. Pour in about 350 ml water, enough to come roughly halfway up the chicken.
Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer gently for 20–25 minutes until the chicken and potatoes are fully cooked.
Remove the lid and simmer for another 3–5 minutes if the sauce is too thin. Stir in sesame oil at the end.
Serve the chicken and potatoes over hot rice with some of the sauce.
stepsZh: 鸡肉切成适中大小，马铃薯去皮切块。
将酱油、黑酱油、糖和料酒混合备用。
锅中加入食油，炒香姜和蒜约30秒。
加入鸡肉煎炒2–3分钟，让表面稍微上色。
加入马铃薯和酱油混合液，再加入约350毫升水，水量大约到鸡肉的一半高度即可。
煮滚后盖上锅盖，小火焖煮20–25分钟，直到鸡肉和马铃薯熟透。
如果酱汁太稀，可打开锅盖再煮3–5分钟。最后加入麻油。
将鸡肉和马铃薯放在热米饭上，淋上适量酱汁享用。

steps: Season the chicken lightly.
Heat oil in a frying pan and brown the chicken.
Add garlic, ginger and potato.
Add soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar and Shaoxing wine.
Add water, cover and simmer until the potato is tender and chicken is fully cooked.
Finish with sesame oil and serve with rice.
stepsZh: 鸡肉简单调味。
锅中加油，将鸡肉煎至表面金黄。
加入蒜、姜和马铃薯。
加入酱油、黑酱油、糖和绍兴酒。
加入水，盖上锅盖焖至马铃薯软熟、鸡肉熟透。
最后加入麻油，搭配米饭享用。

steps: Wash the rice and place it in the rice cooker.
Add the chicken, potato, garlic and ginger on top of the rice.
Mix soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar and Shaoxing wine, then pour over the chicken.
Add the normal amount of water needed for your rice, taking the added sauce into account.
Cook until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches a safe internal temperature.
Rest for 5 minutes, fluff the rice and serve.
stepsZh: 将米洗净放入电饭锅。
把鸡肉、马铃薯、蒜和姜放在米饭上。
将酱油、黑酱油、糖和绍兴酒混合后淋在鸡肉上。
加入平时煮米所需的水量，并考虑酱汁带来的液体。
煮至米饭熟透，鸡肉达到安全熟度。
静置5分钟后拌松米饭并享用。

name: Tomato & Egg Stir-Fry
description: A classic Chinese home-style dish with soft eggs and lightly sweet tomato sauce.
descriptionZh: 经典中式家常菜，嫩滑鸡蛋搭配微甜番茄酱汁。
steps: Cut the tomatoes into wedges. Whisk the eggs with about 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok. Scramble the eggs until softly set, then remove immediately.
Add the remaining oil. Fry the garlic and spring onion whites for about 20 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until softened and juicy.
Add the sugar and remaining salt. Cook for another 30–60 seconds. Taste and adjust the sugar depending on how sour the tomatoes are.
Return the eggs and gently fold everything together for about 30 seconds.
Finish with white pepper and spring onion greens. Serve immediately.
stepsZh: 番茄切块，鸡蛋打散并加入约1/4茶匙盐。
锅中加入1汤匙油，把鸡蛋炒至刚刚凝固但仍然嫩滑，立即盛起。
加入剩余的油，炒香蒜和青葱白色部分约20秒。
加入番茄翻炒2–3分钟，直到番茄变软并出汁。
加入糖和剩余的盐，再煮30–60秒。根据番茄的酸度调整糖量。
把鸡蛋放回锅中，轻轻翻拌约30秒。
撒上白胡椒和青葱即可趁热享用。

steps: Beat the eggs with a small pinch of salt.
Heat oil in a frying pan and scramble the eggs until mostly set; remove.
Add a little more oil and stir-fry the garlic and tomatoes.
Add sugar, salt and white pepper.
Return the eggs and toss gently until the sauce coats them.
Finish with spring onion and sesame oil.
stepsZh: 鸡蛋加少许盐打散。
锅中加油，将鸡蛋炒至大部分凝固后盛出。
加入少量油，炒香蒜和番茄。
加入糖、盐和白胡椒。
把鸡蛋放回锅中轻轻翻炒，让酱汁裹住鸡蛋。
最后加入青葱和麻油。

name: Malaysian Chicken Curry
description: A comforting Malaysian curry with chicken, potatoes, curry powder and coconut milk.
descriptionZh: 经典马来西亚家常咖喱鸡，搭配马铃薯、咖喱粉和椰奶。
steps: Cut the chicken into medium pieces and cut the potatoes into large chunks.
Crush the lemongrass. Finely chop the onion, garlic, ginger and chili.
Heat the oil in a pot. Fry the onion, garlic, ginger, chili and lemongrass for 2–3 minutes.
Add the curry powder and stir constantly for about 30 seconds so it becomes fragrant. Do not let it burn.
Add the chicken and stir-fry for 2 minutes to coat it in the spices.
Add about 350 ml water and the potatoes. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for about 25 minutes until the potatoes and chicken are cooked.
Lower the heat and stir in the coconut milk. Simmer gently for 5 minutes; avoid a hard boil after adding coconut milk.
Season with salt. If the curry is too thin, simmer uncovered for a few more minutes. Serve with rice.
stepsZh: 鸡肉切成适中大小，马铃薯切成较大块。
香茅拍扁，洋葱、蒜、姜和辣椒切碎。
锅中加入油，炒香洋葱、蒜、姜、辣椒和香茅2–3分钟。
加入咖喱粉，小心翻炒约30秒让香味释放，不要烧焦。
加入鸡肉翻炒约2分钟，让鸡肉均匀裹上香料。
加入约350毫升水和马铃薯，煮滚后盖锅，小火焖煮约25分钟，直到鸡肉和马铃薯熟透。
转小火加入椰奶，再轻轻煮5分钟；加入椰奶后不要大火沸腾。
加入盐调味。如果咖喱太稀，可打开锅盖再煮几分钟收汁，配饭享用。

steps: Heat oil in a deep frying pan or pot.
Fry garlic, ginger, chili and lemongrass until fragrant.
Add curry powder and stir briefly to release its aroma.
Add chicken and coat well with the spice mixture.
Add potatoes and water, then simmer until the chicken and potatoes are cooked.
Stir in coconut milk and simmer gently for a few minutes.
Season with salt and serve with rice.
stepsZh: 深锅或平底锅加油烧热。
加入蒜、姜、辣椒和香茅炒香。
加入咖喱粉短暂翻炒，让香味释放。
加入鸡肉并与香料拌匀。
加入马铃薯和水，焖煮至鸡肉和马铃薯熟透。
加入椰浆，小火煮几分钟。
加盐调味，搭配米饭享用。

steps: Add oil, garlic, ginger, chili, lemongrass and curry powder to the rice cooker pot and use its cook/sauté function if available.
Add chicken and potatoes and stir to coat.
Add water and cook until the chicken and potatoes are nearly tender.
Add coconut milk and salt, then continue cooking until the chicken is fully cooked and the curry is hot.
Serve with separately cooked rice.
stepsZh: 将油、蒜、姜、辣椒、香茅和咖喱粉放入电饭锅；如果有煎炒功能可先炒香。
加入鸡肉和马铃薯拌匀。
加入水并煮至鸡肉和马铃薯接近熟透。
加入椰浆和盐，继续煮至鸡肉熟透、咖喱彻底加热。
搭配另外煮好的米饭享用。

name: Black Pepper Beef
description: Tender beef stir-fried with onion, capsicum and a savoury black pepper sauce.
descriptionZh: 嫩牛肉配洋葱、灯笼椒和香浓黑椒酱汁。
steps: Slice the beef thinly across the grain.
Mix the beef with 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, 1/2 tablespoon soy sauce, cooking wine, cornstarch and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper. Marinate for 15 minutes.
Mix the remaining oyster sauce, soy sauce, black pepper and sesame oil with 2 tablespoons water to make the sauce.
Heat a wok until very hot. Add the oil and sear the beef in a single layer in batches if necessary. Remove once browned and mostly cooked.
Stir-fry the onion, capsicum and garlic for 1–2 minutes while keeping them slightly crisp.
Return the beef and pour in the sauce. Toss over high heat for 30–60 seconds until glossy and the beef is fully cooked.
Serve immediately with steamed rice.
stepsZh: 牛肉逆纹切成薄片。
牛肉加入1汤匙蚝油、1/2汤匙酱油、料酒、玉米淀粉和1/2茶匙黑胡椒，腌15分钟。
将剩余的蚝油、酱油、黑胡椒和麻油加入2汤匙水调成酱汁。
锅烧热后加入油，把牛肉分批快速煎炒至表面上色、约八成熟，盛起。
加入洋葱、灯笼椒和蒜炒1–2分钟，保持蔬菜微脆。
把牛肉放回锅中，加入酱汁，大火快速翻炒30–60秒，直到酱汁裹住牛肉且牛肉熟透。
立即配白饭享用。

steps: Slice the beef thinly against the grain.
Heat oil in a wok or frying pan over high heat.
Sear the beef in batches so the pan stays hot.
Add garlic, onion and capsicum and stir-fry until crisp-tender.
Return the beef and add oyster sauce, soy sauce, black pepper and Shaoxing wine.
Toss with the cornstarch mixture until the sauce lightly thickens.
Finish with sesame oil and serve.
stepsZh: 牛肉逆纹切薄片。
锅中大火加油烧热。
分批煎炒牛肉，保持锅温。
加入蒜、洋葱和彩椒翻炒至刚熟。
放回牛肉，加入蚝油、酱油、黑胡椒和绍兴酒。
加入玉米淀粉调好的液体，翻炒至酱汁稍浓。
最后加入麻油后享用。

name: Kung Pao Chicken
description: A balanced Sichuan-style stir-fry with chicken, dried chilies, peanuts and a tangy savoury sauce.
descriptionZh: 鸡肉、干辣椒和花生搭配酸香咸鲜酱汁的宫保鸡丁。
steps: Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces. Toss with 1/2 tablespoon soy sauce and the cornstarch. Rest for 15 minutes.
Mix the remaining soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil and 2 tablespoons water.
Heat the wok over medium-high heat. Add the oil and stir-fry the chicken until browned and almost cooked through, about 3–4 minutes. Remove.
Lower the heat slightly. Add the dried chilies, garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 20–30 seconds until fragrant. Do not burn the chilies.
Add the capsicum and spring onion whites and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Return the chicken and add the sauce. Toss for 1–2 minutes until the sauce lightly thickens and the chicken is fully cooked.
Turn off the heat and fold in the peanuts and spring onion greens. Serve immediately.
stepsZh: 鸡肉切成约2.5厘米小块，加入1/2汤匙酱油和玉米淀粉拌匀，腌15分钟。
将剩余酱油、醋、糖、麻油和2汤匙水混合成酱汁。
锅中大火加热，加入油，把鸡肉炒至表面上色、约八成熟，约3–4分钟后盛起。
转中火，加入干辣椒、蒜和姜炒20–30秒至香，但不要把辣椒炒焦。
加入灯笼椒和青葱白色部分炒1分钟。
把鸡肉放回锅中，加入酱汁翻炒1–2分钟，直到酱汁稍微浓稠且鸡肉熟透。
关火后拌入花生和青葱绿色部分，立即享用。

steps: Mix the chicken with cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok or frying pan.
Stir-fry the chicken until nearly cooked and remove if the pan is crowded.
Fry dried chili, garlic and ginger briefly.
Add capsicum and stir-fry.
Return chicken and add soy sauce, vinegar and sugar.
Add peanuts and sesame oil, toss until the sauce coats everything, then serve.
stepsZh: 鸡肉与玉米淀粉拌匀。
锅中加油烧热。
炒鸡肉至接近熟透；如果锅太挤可先盛出。
快速炒香干辣椒、蒜和姜。
加入彩椒翻炒。
放回鸡肉，加入酱油、醋和糖。
加入花生和麻油翻炒至酱汁裹住食材后享用。

name: Mapo Tofu
description: Silky tofu cooked in a spicy, savoury Sichuan-style sauce with doubanjiang.
descriptionZh: 嫩滑豆腐搭配豆瓣酱和花椒香味的经典川味麻婆豆腐。
steps: Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes. If it is very soft, blanch it in gently boiling water for 1 minute, then drain.
Mix the cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water to make a slurry.
Heat the oil in a wok. Add the Sichuan pepper, dried chili, garlic and ginger and stir-fry for about 20 seconds.
Add the pork and stir-fry until fully cooked and broken into small pieces.
Add the doubanjiang and fry for 30 seconds until the oil becomes reddish and fragrant.
Add about 180 ml water, soy sauce and sugar. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the tofu and simmer gently for 3–5 minutes. Avoid vigorous stirring so the tofu keeps its shape.
Stir the slurry again and add it gradually until the sauce is glossy and lightly thickened. Stir in sesame oil.
Garnish with spring onion and a small extra pinch of Sichuan pepper if desired. Serve with rice.
stepsZh: 豆腐切成约2厘米方块。如果豆腐很嫩，可放入微滚的水中焯1分钟后沥干。
玉米淀粉加入2汤匙水调成芡汁。
锅中加入油，放入花椒、干辣椒、蒜和姜炒约20秒。
加入猪肉炒至完全熟透，并把肉炒散。
加入豆瓣酱炒约30秒，直到油变红并散发香味。
加入约180毫升水、酱油和糖，小火煮至微滚。
加入豆腐，小火煮3–5分钟。不要大力翻炒，以免豆腐碎掉。
重新搅匀芡汁，逐渐加入锅中，煮至酱汁有光泽并稍微浓稠。加入麻油。
撒上青葱，喜欢的话再加少量花椒，配饭享用。

steps: Heat oil in a wok or deep frying pan.
Fry garlic, ginger and doubanjiang until fragrant.
Add pork and cook through.
Add water or stock, soy sauce and sugar.
Add tofu gently and simmer for several minutes.
Add Sichuan pepper and cornstarch slurry to thicken.
Finish with sesame oil and spring onion.
stepsZh: 锅中加油烧热。
加入蒜、姜和豆瓣酱炒香。
加入猪肉炒熟。
加入水或高汤、酱油和糖。
轻轻加入豆腐，焖煮几分钟。
加入花椒和玉米淀粉水勾芡。
最后加入麻油和青葱。

name: Malaysian Fried Noodles
description: Mamak-style fried yellow noodles with egg, vegetables and a sweet-savoury sauce.
descriptionZh: 马来西亚嘛嘛档风味炒黄面，搭配鸡蛋、蔬菜和咸甜酱汁。
steps: Boil the potato until just tender, cool slightly and cut into chunks. Cut the tofu into cubes.
Mix soy sauce, dark soy sauce, tomato sauce, sambal and sugar.
Heat half the oil in a wok. Fry the tofu until lightly golden, then add the potato and toss for 1 minute. Push aside.
Add the remaining oil and scramble the eggs until just set.
Add the garlic, noodles and sauce mixture. Toss over high heat for 2–3 minutes until the noodles are evenly coated and hot.
Add the bean sprouts and stir-fry for 30–60 seconds so they stay slightly crisp.
Taste before adding any salt because the sauces are already salty. Finish with lime juice and serve.
stepsZh: 马铃薯煮至刚刚熟，稍微放凉后切块；豆腐切块。
将酱油、黑酱油、番茄酱、参巴酱和糖混合。
锅中加入一半油，把豆腐煎至微金黄，再加入马铃薯翻炒1分钟，推到锅边。
加入剩余的油，把鸡蛋炒至刚刚凝固。
加入蒜、黄面和酱汁，大火翻炒2–3分钟，让面条均匀上色并彻底加热。
加入豆芽翻炒30–60秒，保持一点脆度。
先试味再决定是否需要加盐，因为酱料本身已经有盐分。最后挤入青柠汁即可。

steps: Loosen the noodles before cooking.
Heat oil in a wok or frying pan.
Fry garlic, potato and tofu until lightly browned.
Add egg and scramble.
Add noodles, soy sauces, tomato sauce and sambal.
Stir-fry until the noodles are hot and evenly coated.
Add bean sprouts near the end and toss briefly.
Finish with lime and serve.
stepsZh: 先将面条拨散。
锅中加油烧热。
加入蒜、马铃薯和豆腐炒至微金黄。
加入鸡蛋炒熟。
加入面条、酱油、黑酱油、番茄酱和参巴。
翻炒至面条热透并均匀裹上酱汁。
最后加入豆芽快速翻炒。
挤上青柠后享用。

name: Sambal Prawn
description: Juicy prawns cooked in a balanced Malaysian sambal sauce.
descriptionZh: 鲜嫩大虾搭配香辣、微甜、带酸味的马来西亚参巴酱。
steps: Clean and devein the prawns. Pat them dry.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok and sear the prawns for about 1 minute per side. Remove while they are still slightly undercooked.
Add the remaining oil. Fry the onion and garlic for 1 minute.
Add the sambal and fry for 1–2 minutes until fragrant and the oil starts to separate.
Add sugar, vinegar and salt. Stir and taste. The sauce should be spicy, savoury, slightly sweet and slightly tangy.
Return the prawns and toss for 1–2 minutes until just cooked through. Do not overcook.
Serve hot with rice.
stepsZh: 虾去壳去肠泥并擦干。
锅中加入1汤匙油，将虾每面煎约1分钟，虾还没完全熟就先盛起。
加入剩余的油，炒香洋葱和蒜约1分钟。
加入参巴酱炒1–2分钟，直到香味出来并开始出油。
加入糖、醋和盐。试味，酱汁应该是香辣、咸鲜、微甜并带一点酸味。
把虾放回锅中翻炒1–2分钟至刚刚熟透，不要煮过头。
趁热配饭享用。

steps: Heat oil in a frying pan.
Fry garlic and onion until fragrant.
Add sambal and cook briefly.
Add prawns and stir-fry until pink and fully cooked.
Add sugar, vinegar and salt.
Toss for another minute and serve immediately.
stepsZh: 锅中加油烧热。
加入蒜和洋葱炒香。
加入参巴短暂翻炒。
加入虾仁翻炒至变粉红并熟透。
加入糖、醋和盐。
再翻炒约一分钟后立即享用。

steps: Toss the prawns with a little cooking oil and salt.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C.
Air-fry the prawns in a single layer for about 5–7 minutes, turning once, until fully cooked.
Meanwhile, warm the sambal, garlic, onion, sugar and vinegar in a small pan.
Toss the cooked prawns with the sambal sauce and serve.
stepsZh: 虾仁加入少量油和盐拌匀。
空气炸锅预热至190°C。
虾仁单层放入炸篮，约炸5–7分钟，中途翻一次，确保熟透。
同时在小锅中加热参巴、蒜、洋葱、糖和醋。
将熟虾与参巴酱拌匀后享用。

name: Vegetable Omelette
description: A quick, fluffy omelette packed with everyday vegetables.
descriptionZh: 简单快速、加入家常蔬菜的嫩滑煎蛋。
steps: Thinly slice the carrot, onion and capsicum. Slice the spring onion.
Beat the eggs with salt and black pepper.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Stir-fry the vegetables for 2 minutes until slightly softened.
Pour in the eggs and lower the heat to medium-low.
Let the eggs set around the edges, then gently lift the edges so uncooked egg flows underneath.
Cook until almost fully set, then fold the omelette in half. Cook for another 30–60 seconds.
Serve immediately.
stepsZh: 胡萝卜、洋葱和灯笼椒切薄片，青葱切段。
鸡蛋加入盐和黑胡椒打散。
不粘锅加入油，中火炒蔬菜约2分钟，炒至稍微软化。
倒入蛋液，转中小火。
等边缘开始凝固后，用锅铲轻轻抬起边缘，让未凝固的蛋液流到底部。
鸡蛋几乎完全凝固后对折，再煎30–60秒。
立即享用。

steps: Beat the eggs with salt and black pepper.
Mix in carrot, onion, spring onion and capsicum.
Heat oil in a non-stick frying pan.
Pour in the egg mixture and spread it evenly.
Cook over medium-low heat until the bottom is set and the top is nearly set.
Flip carefully or cover briefly to finish cooking.
Serve hot.
stepsZh: 鸡蛋加盐和黑胡椒打散。
加入胡萝卜、洋葱、青葱和彩椒。
不粘锅加油烧热。
倒入蛋液并铺匀。
中小火煮至底部凝固、表面接近凝固。
小心翻面或盖锅短暂焖熟。
趁热享用。

name: Sweet & Sour Pork
description: Crispy pork coated in a glossy sweet-and-sour sauce with pineapple and peppers.
descriptionZh: 酥脆猪肉裹上酸甜酱汁，搭配菠萝和灯笼椒。
steps: Cut the pork into bite-sized pieces. Season with a pinch of salt.
Beat the egg. Dip the pork in egg, then coat thoroughly with the flour and cornstarch mixture.
Heat enough oil for shallow/deep frying to about 175°C. Fry the pork in batches until golden and cooked through, about 3–5 minutes depending on size. Drain well.
Mix tomato sauce, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar and 3 tablespoons water in a bowl.
Heat 1 teaspoon fresh oil in a clean wok. Stir-fry the garlic, onion and capsicum for 1–2 minutes.
Add the pineapple and sauce mixture. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 1–2 minutes until glossy.
Add the fried pork and toss quickly for 30–60 seconds, just enough to coat it. Serve immediately so the pork stays crisp.
stepsZh: 猪肉切成一口大小，加入少量盐调味。
鸡蛋打散。猪肉先沾蛋液，再均匀裹上面粉和玉米淀粉混合物。
油加热至约175°C，分批把猪肉炸至金黄并熟透，视大小约3–5分钟，捞起沥油。
将番茄酱、醋、酱油、糖和3汤匙水混合。
干净的锅中加入1茶匙新油，炒香蒜、洋葱和灯笼椒1–2分钟。
加入菠萝和酱汁，煮至微滚并变得有光泽，约1–2分钟。
加入炸好的猪肉快速翻拌30–60秒，让酱汁均匀裹住即可。马上享用，保持猪肉酥脆。

steps: Coat the pork with egg, flour and cornstarch.
Heat oil in a frying pan and shallow-fry the pork in batches until cooked and crisp.
Remove excess oil, leaving a small amount in the pan.
Stir-fry onion and capsicum briefly.
Add pineapple, tomato sauce, vinegar, soy sauce and sugar.
Return the pork and toss quickly until coated.
Serve immediately to keep the pork crisp.
stepsZh: 猪肉与鸡蛋、面粉和玉米淀粉拌匀。
锅中加油分批煎炸猪肉至熟透酥脆。
倒掉多余油，锅中留少量。
加入洋葱和彩椒快速翻炒。
加入菠萝、番茄酱、醋、酱油和糖。
放回猪肉快速翻炒，让酱汁裹匀。
立即享用，保持酥脆。

name: Soy Garlic Chicken Rice
description: Simple tender chicken cooked with garlic and soy sauce, served with rice.
descriptionZh: 简单的蒜香酱油鸡，搭配米饭，非常适合家常烹饪。
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Mince the garlic and slice the ginger if using.
Heat cooking oil in a pan.
Fry the garlic until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until lightly browned.
Add soy sauce and a little water.
Add potato if using and simmer until tender.
Cook until the chicken is fully cooked and the sauce slightly thickens.
Serve with cooked rice.
stepsZh: 将鸡肉切成适口大小。
将蒜切碎，如果使用姜则切片。
锅中加入食用油并烧热。
加入蒜炒香。
加入鸡肉，炒至表面微微金黄。
加入酱油和少量水。
如果使用马铃薯，加入后煮至软熟。
煮至鸡肉熟透，酱汁稍微浓稠。
搭配米饭享用。

steps: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a frying pan and fry garlic until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook until lightly browned.
Add soy sauce and a little water.
Add potato if using and simmer until tender.
Cook until the chicken is fully cooked and the sauce slightly thickens.
Serve with cooked rice.
stepsZh: 将鸡肉切成适口大小。
锅中加油，炒香蒜。
加入鸡肉炒至表面微金黄。
加入酱油和少量水。
如果使用马铃薯，加入后焖至软熟。
煮至鸡肉熟透、酱汁稍微浓稠。
搭配米饭享用。

steps: Marinate the chicken with soy sauce and minced garlic for at least 10 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C.
Place the chicken in a single layer in the basket.
Air-fry for about 12–16 minutes, turning halfway, until the thickest piece is fully cooked.
If using potato, cut it into small pieces and air-fry until tender.
Serve the chicken and potato over cooked rice.
stepsZh: 鸡肉加入酱油和蒜末腌制至少10分钟。
空气炸锅预热至190°C。
鸡肉单层放入炸篮。
约炸12–16分钟，中途翻面，确保最厚处熟透。
如果使用马铃薯，将其切小块并炸至软熟。
将鸡肉和马铃薯放在米饭上享用。

steps: Wash the rice and place it in the rice cooker.
Add chicken, garlic and soy sauce.
Add potato if using and add the normal amount of water needed for your rice, adjusting for the added sauce.
Cook until the rice is tender and the chicken is fully cooked.
Rest for 5 minutes, fluff the rice and serve.
stepsZh: 将米洗净放入电饭锅。
加入鸡肉、蒜和酱油。
如果使用马铃薯则加入，并按米种加入平时所需水量，同时考虑酱汁液体。
煮至米饭熟透、鸡肉完全熟透。
静置5分钟后拌松米饭并享用。

name: Chicken Potato Rice
description: A simple one-pan chicken and potato dish served with rice.
descriptionZh: 简单的鸡肉土豆家常菜，搭配米饭。
steps: Cut the chicken and potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a pan.
Fry garlic and onion until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook until lightly browned.
Add potatoes and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce and enough water to partially cover the potatoes.
Cover and simmer until the potatoes are tender and chicken is fully cooked.
Serve with cooked rice.
stepsZh: 将鸡肉和马铃薯切成适口大小。
锅中加入食用油并烧热。
加入蒜和洋葱炒香。
加入鸡肉炒至表面微微金黄。
加入马铃薯翻炒约2分钟。
加入酱油和适量水，水量盖过马铃薯一部分即可。
盖上锅盖焖煮至马铃薯软熟、鸡肉熟透。
搭配米饭享用。

steps: Cut the chicken and potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in a frying pan.
Fry garlic and onion if using until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook until lightly browned.
Add potatoes and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce and enough water to partially cover the potatoes.
Cover and simmer until the potatoes are tender and chicken is fully cooked.
Serve with cooked rice.
stepsZh: 将鸡肉和马铃薯切成适口大小。
锅中加油烧热。
加入蒜和洋葱（如果有）炒香。
加入鸡肉炒至表面微金黄。
加入马铃薯翻炒2分钟。
加入酱油和适量水，水量盖过马铃薯一部分即可。
盖锅焖至马铃薯软熟、鸡肉熟透。
搭配米饭享用。

steps: Cut chicken and potatoes into similar-sized pieces.
Toss them with a little cooking oil, garlic and soy sauce.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C.
Air-fry the potatoes for about 8 minutes first.
Add the chicken and continue air-frying for about 12–15 minutes, turning halfway, until both are fully cooked.
Serve with cooked rice.
stepsZh: 将鸡肉和马铃薯切成大小相近的小块。
加入少量油、蒜和酱油拌匀。
空气炸锅预热至190°C。
先将马铃薯炸约8分钟。
加入鸡肉继续炸约12–15分钟，中途翻动，确保全部熟透。
搭配米饭享用。

steps: Wash the rice and place it in the rice cooker.
Add chicken, potato, garlic and soy sauce.
Add the normal amount of water needed for your rice, accounting for the added sauce.
Cook until the rice is tender and the chicken and potatoes are fully cooked.
Rest for 5 minutes, fluff the rice and serve.
stepsZh: 将米洗净放入电饭锅。
加入鸡肉、马铃薯、蒜和酱油。
按米种加入平时所需水量，同时考虑酱汁带来的液体。
煮至米饭熟透，鸡肉和马铃薯完全熟透。
静置5分钟后拌松米饭并享用。

name: One-Pot Soy Chicken Potato Rice
description: A comforting one-pot rice dish with chicken, potato, garlic and soy sauce.
descriptionZh: 鸡肉、土豆、蒜和酱油一起煮成的简单一锅饭。
steps: Wash the rice and drain well.
Cut the chicken and potato into small pieces.
Heat oil in a pot and fry garlic until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook for 2–3 minutes.
Add potato and soy sauce and stir well.
Add the rice and the appropriate amount of water for the rice you are using.
Bring to a boil, then cover and cook over low heat until the rice is tender and chicken is fully cooked.
Rest for 5 minutes before fluffing the rice.
Top with spring onion if available and serve.
stepsZh: 将米洗净并沥干。
将鸡肉和马铃薯切成小块。
锅中加入食用油，炒香蒜。
加入鸡肉翻炒2–3分钟。
加入马铃薯和酱油，翻炒均匀。
加入米饭，再加入适合所用米种的水量。
煮沸后盖上锅盖，用小火煮至米饭熟透、鸡肉完全熟透。
关火后静置5分钟，再将米饭拌松。
如果有青葱，可撒在上面后享用。

steps: Wash the rice and drain well.
Cut the chicken and potato into small pieces.
Add rice, chicken, potato, garlic and soy sauce to the rice cooker.
Add the appropriate amount of water for the rice you are using.
Start the rice cooker and cook until the rice is tender and chicken is fully cooked.
Rest for 5 minutes before fluffing the rice.
Top with spring onion if available and serve.
stepsZh: 将米洗净并沥干。
将鸡肉和马铃薯切成小块。
把米、鸡肉、马铃薯、蒜和酱油放入电饭锅。
加入适合所用米种的水量。
启动电饭锅，煮至米饭熟透、鸡肉完全熟透。
静置5分钟后拌松米饭。
如果有青葱，可撒上后享用。

steps: Cook the rice separately.
Cut the chicken and potato into small pieces.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan or wok and fry garlic until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook until nearly done.
Add potato and enough water to simmer until tender.
Add soy sauce and cook until the sauce reduces slightly.
Serve the chicken and potato over cooked rice.
stepsZh: 先另外煮好米饭。
将鸡肉和马铃薯切成小块。
深平底锅或炒锅加油，炒香蒜。
加入鸡肉炒至接近熟透。
加入马铃薯和适量水，焖至软熟。
加入酱油煮至酱汁稍微收浓。
将鸡肉和马铃薯铺在米饭上享用。

name: Hainanese Chicken Rice
description: Tender poached chicken with fragrant ginger-garlic rice and a light soy finish.
descriptionZh: 嫩滑白切鸡搭配姜蒜香饭和清香酱油。
steps: Rub the chicken lightly with salt and set aside for 10 minutes.
Poach the chicken gently until the thickest part reaches 74°C, then rest it covered for 10 minutes.
Fry ginger and garlic in cooking oil for 30 seconds. Add the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Add pandan leaf and enough water to cook the rice according to the rice you are using.
Slice the chicken. Mix soy sauce and sesame oil for a simple dipping sauce.
Serve chicken with fragrant rice and cucumber, with the sauce on the side.
stepsZh: 鸡肉轻轻抹上盐，静置10分钟。
将鸡肉小火煮熟，最厚处达到74°C后取出，盖好静置10分钟。
食油中炒姜和蒜约30秒，加入米饭翻炒1分钟。
加入香兰叶和适量水，按照所用米饭的正常方法煮熟。
鸡肉切片，将酱油和麻油混合成简单蘸酱。
鸡肉配香饭和黄瓜一起享用，蘸酱另放。

steps: Rub the chicken lightly with salt and set aside for 10 minutes.
Poach the chicken gently until the thickest part reaches 74°C, then rest it covered for 10 minutes.
Fry ginger and garlic in cooking oil for 30 seconds. Add the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Add pandan leaf and enough water to cook the rice according to the rice you are using.
Slice the chicken. Mix soy sauce and sesame oil for a simple dipping sauce.
Serve chicken with fragrant rice and cucumber, with the sauce on the side.
stepsZh: 鸡肉轻轻抹上盐，静置10分钟。
将鸡肉小火煮熟，最厚处达到74°C后取出，盖好静置10分钟。
食油中炒姜和蒜约30秒，加入米饭翻炒1分钟。
加入香兰叶和适量水，按照所用米饭的正常方法煮熟。
鸡肉切片，将酱油和麻油混合成简单蘸酱。
鸡肉配香饭和黄瓜一起享用，蘸酱另放。

name: Ayam Masak Kicap
description: Malaysian soy-braised chicken with potato, onion, ginger and a rich savoury sauce.
descriptionZh: 马来西亚风味酱油鸡，搭配马铃薯、洋葱和姜，酱汁浓郁。
steps: Season the chicken lightly with salt.
Heat oil and brown chicken and potato pieces in batches. Remove.
Fry onion, garlic, ginger and chili for 1–2 minutes.
Add oyster sauce, soy sauce, dark soy sauce and sugar with 250 ml water.
Return chicken and potato. Simmer covered for 15–18 minutes.
Uncover and reduce the sauce until glossy and lightly thick. Taste before adding more salt.
Serve hot with steamed rice.
stepsZh: 鸡肉轻轻加入盐调味。
锅中加油，把鸡肉和马铃薯分批煎至表面上色，盛起。
炒洋葱、蒜、姜和辣椒1–2分钟。
加入蚝油、酱油、黑酱油、糖和250毫升水。
放回鸡肉和马铃薯，盖锅盖小火焖15–18分钟。
打开锅盖收汁至酱汁有光泽并稍浓，试味后才决定是否加盐。
趁热配白饭享用。

Heat oil and brown chicken and potato pieces in batches. Remove.
Fry onion, garlic, ginger and chili for 1–2 minutes.
Add oyster sauce, soy sauce, dark soy sauce and sugar with 250 ml water.
Return chicken and potato. Simmer covered for 15–18 minutes.

放回鸡肉和马铃薯，盖锅盖小火焖15–18分钟。
打开锅盖收汁至酱汁有光泽并稍浓，试味后才决定是否加盐。
趁热配白饭享用。

name: Char Kway Teow
description: Smoky Malaysian-style stir-fried flat rice noodles with prawns, egg and bean sprouts.
descriptionZh: 马来西亚风味大火炒粿条，搭配虾、鸡蛋和豆芽。
steps: Mix soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and 2 tablespoons water.
Heat a wok until very hot. Add oil and stir-fry garlic for 15 seconds.
Add prawns and fish cake. Cook for about 1 minute.
Push everything aside and scramble the eggs.
Add kway teow and sauce. Toss over high heat for 2–3 minutes.
Add bean sprouts and toss for another 30–45 seconds. Serve immediately.
stepsZh: 将酱油、黑酱油、蚝油、糖和2汤匙水混合。
锅烧热后加入油，炒蒜约15秒。
加入虾和鱼饼，炒约1分钟。
把食材推到一边，加入鸡蛋炒散。
加入粿条和酱汁，大火快速翻炒2–3分钟。
加入豆芽再炒30–45秒，马上享用。

steps: Mix soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and 2 tablespoons water.
Heat a wok until very hot. Add oil and stir-fry garlic for 15 seconds.
Add prawns and fish cake. Cook for about 1 minute.
Push everything aside and scramble the eggs.
Add kway teow and sauce. Toss over high heat for 2–3 minutes.
Add bean sprouts and toss for another 30–45 seconds. Serve immediately.
stepsZh: 将酱油、黑酱油、蚝油、糖和2汤匙水混合。
锅烧热后加入油，炒蒜约15秒。
加入虾和鱼饼，炒约1分钟。
把食材推到一边，加入鸡蛋炒散。
加入粿条和酱汁，大火快速翻炒2–3分钟。
加入豆芽再炒30–45秒，马上享用。

name: Mee Goreng Mamak
description: A Malaysian mamak-style fried noodle dish with egg, potato, tofu and a sweet-spicy sauce.
descriptionZh: 马来西亚嘛嘛档风味炒面，搭配鸡蛋、马铃薯、豆腐和甜辣酱汁。
steps: Boil potato until tender, cool slightly and cut into chunks. Cut tofu into cubes.
Mix sambal, tomato sauce, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, curry powder and 2 tablespoons water.
Heat oil. Fry tofu and potato until lightly browned, then push aside.
Scramble eggs, then add garlic and tomato.
Add noodles and sauce. Toss over high heat for 2–3 minutes.
Add bean sprouts and toss for 30 seconds. Finish with lime juice.

description: A Malaysian curry noodle bowl with chicken, tofu, fish cake and creamy coconut broth.
descriptionZh: 马来西亚咖喱面，搭配鸡肉、豆腐、鱼饼和浓郁椰奶咖喱汤。
steps: Cut chicken, tofu and fish cake into bite-sized pieces.
Fry onion, garlic, ginger and chili in oil for 2 minutes.
Add curry powder and fry for 1 minute.
Add 400 ml water and chicken. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add coconut milk, tofu and fish cake. Simmer gently for 5 minutes; do not boil hard.
Season with salt.
Blanch noodles and bean sprouts separately, then place in bowls.
Pour over hot curry broth and serve.
stepsZh: 鸡肉、豆腐和鱼饼切成一口大小。

加入咖喱粉炒1分钟。
加入400毫升水和鸡肉，小火煮10分钟。
加入椰奶、豆腐和鱼饼，小火再煮5分钟，不要大滚。
加入盐调味。
面条和豆芽分别焯熟后放入碗中。
倒入热咖喱汤，马上享用。

description: Tender squid cooked quickly in a fragrant Malaysian sambal sauce.
descriptionZh: 鲜嫩苏东快速炒入香辣马来西亚参巴酱。
steps: Clean squid, cut into rings and pat very dry.
Sear squid over high heat for 60–90 seconds. Remove.
Fry onion and garlic for 1 minute.
Add sambal and fry for 1–2 minutes.
Add tomato, sugar, vinegar and salt and cook until tomato softens.
Return squid and toss for 30–60 seconds only. Serve immediately.
stepsZh: 苏东清洗后切圈并彻底擦干。

加入参巴酱炒1–2分钟至香。
加入番茄、糖、醋和盐，煮至番茄变软。
放回苏东快速翻炒30–60秒，立即关火。

name: Nasi Lemak
description: Fragrant coconut rice served with egg, cucumber and sambal.
descriptionZh: 香浓椰浆饭搭配鸡蛋、黄瓜和参巴酱。
steps: Rinse rice until water is mostly clear.
Cook rice with coconut milk, pandan leaves, salt and enough water for your rice cooker.
Boil eggs for 8–9 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Warm sambal and add sugar to taste.
Slice cucumber.
Serve coconut rice with sambal, egg and cucumber.
stepsZh: 米洗至水大致清澈。
米加入椰奶、香兰叶、盐和适量水煮熟。
鸡蛋煮8–9分钟，冷却后去壳切半。
加热参巴酱并按口味加入糖。
黄瓜切片。
椰浆饭搭配参巴酱、鸡蛋和黄瓜享用。

description: Quick fried rice vermicelli with egg and crunchy vegetables.
descriptionZh: 快速炒米粉，搭配鸡蛋和爽脆蔬菜。
steps: Soak rice vermicelli in warm water until flexible, then drain well.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, white pepper and 3 tablespoons water.
Scramble eggs in hot oil and break into pieces.
Add garlic, carrot and cabbage and stir-fry for 1–2 minutes.
Add vermicelli and sauce and toss until evenly seasoned and hot.
Add bean sprouts and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Serve.
stepsZh: 米粉用温水泡软后充分沥干。
将酱油、蚝油、白胡椒和3汤匙水混合。
锅中加油炒鸡蛋并弄成小块。
加入蒜、胡萝卜和包菜翻炒1–2分钟。
加入米粉和酱汁翻炒至均匀入味并热透。
加入豆芽再炒30秒即可。

name: Steamed Soy Sauce Fish
description: A simple Chinese-style steamed fish finished with ginger, spring onion and hot soy dressing.
descriptionZh: 简单中式蒸鱼，搭配姜、青葱和热酱油汁。
steps: Pat fish dry and place ginger slices on top and underneath.
Steam until the thickest part is opaque and flakes easily, usually 8–12 minutes depending on thickness.
Mix soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.
Carefully drain excess liquid from the plate.
Top with spring onion and pour over soy dressing.
Heat cooking oil until shimmering and drizzle carefully over the spring onion. Serve immediately.
stepsZh: 鱼擦干，在鱼上和鱼下放姜片。
大火蒸至最厚处完全变白并容易分开，通常8–12分钟。
将酱油、糖和麻油混合。
小心倒掉蒸鱼盘中多余水分。
铺上青葱并淋上酱油汁。
食油加热至微微冒烟，谨慎淋在青葱上，马上享用。

name: Prawn Fried Rice
description: Fast fried rice with prawns, egg and spring onion.
descriptionZh: 快速炒制的虾仁蛋炒饭，搭配青葱。
steps: Pat prawns dry and season very lightly.
Stir-fry prawns in half the oil for 1–2 minutes until just cooked. Remove.
Add remaining oil and scramble eggs until softly set.
Add garlic and rice and stir-fry over high heat for 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce around the hot side of the wok and toss quickly.
Return prawns and add spring onion, white pepper and sesame oil. Toss 30 seconds and serve.
stepsZh: 虾擦干并轻轻调味。
锅中加入一半油，把虾炒1–2分钟至刚熟，盛起。
加入剩余油，把鸡蛋炒至嫩熟。
加入蒜和米饭，大火炒2分钟。
把酱油沿锅边加入，快速翻炒。
加入虾、青葱、白胡椒和麻油，再炒30秒即可。

name: Garlic Soy Tofu
description: Crispy tofu coated in a savoury garlic-soy glaze.
descriptionZh: 香脆豆腐裹上蒜香酱油汁，简单又下饭。
steps: Pat tofu very dry and cut into cubes.
Dust lightly with cornstarch.
Fry tofu on several sides until golden and crisp.
Mix soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil and 2 tablespoons water.
Lower heat. Add garlic and stir-fry for 20–30 seconds.
Pour in sauce and toss tofu gently until glossy.
Finish with spring onion and serve with rice.
stepsZh: 豆腐彻底擦干后切块。
薄薄裹上一层玉米淀粉。
多面煎至金黄酥脆。
将酱油、黑酱油、糖、麻油和2汤匙水混合。
转小火，加入蒜炒20–30秒。
倒入酱汁，轻轻翻拌豆腐至酱汁有光泽。
撒上青葱，配饭享用。

description: Crispy potato and chicken tossed in a sweet-spicy sambal sauce.
descriptionZh: 香脆马铃薯和鸡肉裹上甜辣参巴酱。
steps: Cut chicken and potato into bite-sized pieces.
Pan-fry potato until golden and tender. Remove.
Brown chicken until almost cooked. Remove.
Fry onion and garlic for 1 minute, then add sambal and fry 1–2 minutes.
Add tomato, sugar and salt and cook until tomato softens.
Return chicken and potato and toss 2–3 minutes until fully cooked and coated.
stepsZh: 鸡肉和马铃薯切成一口大小。
马铃薯煎至金黄熟透后盛起。
鸡肉煎至接近熟透，盛起。
炒洋葱和蒜1分钟，加入参巴酱再炒1–2分钟。
加入番茄、糖和盐，煮至番茄变软。
放回鸡肉和马铃薯翻炒2–3分钟至熟透并裹上酱汁。

name: Tomato Prawn Stir-Fry
description: Juicy prawns quickly cooked with tomato, garlic and a light savoury sauce.
descriptionZh: 鲜嫩虾仁搭配番茄、蒜和清爽咸香酱汁快速翻炒。
steps: Cook prawns in half the oil for about 1 minute per side. Remove.
Add remaining oil and fry garlic for 20 seconds.
Add tomatoes and cook 2 minutes until juicy.
Add soy sauce and sugar and toss gently.
Return prawns and cook 1 minute.
Pour in beaten egg and stir gently until just set. Finish with sesame oil and spring onion.
stepsZh: 虾每面炒约1分钟，盛起。
加入剩余油，炒蒜20秒。
加入番茄炒2分钟至出汁。
加入酱油和糖轻轻翻拌。
放回虾再炒1分钟。
倒入蛋液轻轻翻拌至刚凝固，最后加入麻油和青葱。

name: Air Fryer Soy Chicken Wings
description: Sticky soy-garlic chicken wings with crisp edges.
descriptionZh: 外皮微脆、带蒜香酱油风味的鸡翅。
steps: Pat chicken wings dry. Toss with soy sauce, minced garlic, honey and oil.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C for 3 minutes.
Air-fry in one layer for 18–22 minutes, turning halfway, until browned and the thickest part reaches 74°C.
Rest for 3 minutes before serving.
stepsZh: 鸡翅擦干，拌入酱油、蒜末、蜂蜜和食油。
空气炸锅以190°C预热3分钟。
鸡翅单层放入，炸18–22分钟，中途翻面，至上色且最厚处达到74°C。
静置3分钟后享用。

description: Golden potato wedges with garlic and pepper.
descriptionZh: 蒜香黑胡椒金黄薯角。
steps: Cut potatoes into even wedges; rinse and dry well.
Toss with oil, grated garlic, salt and pepper.
Air-fry at 200°C for 18–22 minutes, shaking twice, until tender and crisp.
Season to taste and serve hot.
stepsZh: 土豆切成大小均匀的薯角，冲洗后彻底擦干。
拌入食油、蒜蓉、盐和黑胡椒。
以200°C炸18–22分钟，期间摇动两次，至熟透香脆。
按口味调味，趁热享用。

description: Crisp tofu cubes finished with a savory soy glaze.
descriptionZh: 香脆豆腐块配咸香酱油汁。
steps: Press tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Coat gently with cornstarch and spray or toss with a little oil.
Air-fry at 190°C for 14–16 minutes, shaking once, until crisp.
Mix soy sauce, garlic and sesame oil; toss with the hot tofu just before serving.
stepsZh: 豆腐压干水分，切成2厘米方块。
轻轻裹上玉米淀粉，喷或拌少许油。
以190°C炸14–16分钟，中途摇一次，至香脆。
混合酱油、蒜和麻油；上桌前拌入热豆腐。

description: Tender salmon with a quick soy-garlic finish.
descriptionZh: 嫩滑三文鱼配快速蒜香酱油调味。
steps: Pat salmon dry and place skin-side down in the basket.
Mix garlic, soy sauce, honey and sesame oil; brush over the fish.
Air-fry at 190°C for 8–11 minutes, until it flakes easily and is cooked through.
Rest for 2 minutes before serving.
stepsZh: 三文鱼擦干，鱼皮朝下放入炸篮。
混合蒜、酱油、蜂蜜和麻油，刷在鱼肉上。
以190°C炸8–11分钟，至鱼肉容易剥落并熟透。
静置2分钟后享用。

description: A quick pan pasta with mushrooms, garlic and black pepper.
descriptionZh: 蘑菇、蒜和黑胡椒制作的快速意面。
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until just tender; reserve 120 ml cooking water.
Melt butter in a pan and cook mushrooms until browned.

descriptionZh: 滑嫩蒸水蛋配酱油和葱花。
steps: Whisk eggs with 1.5 times their volume of warm water and salt; strain into a heatproof bowl.
Place the bowl on a rack in a rice cooker with 2 cm water in the pot.

Finish with soy sauce, sesame oil and spring onion.

淋上酱油、麻油，撒上葱花。
